(defvar workflow-count: int 0)
(defn workflow-bump [] -> int (do (inc! workflow-count) workflow-count))
(defn workflow-native [x: int y: int] -> int (+ x y))

(defn workflow-square [x: int] -> int (* x x))
(defn workflow-score [x: int] -> int (+ (workflow-square x) (workflow-native x (workflow-bump))))
(defn workflow-loop [limit: int] -> int
  (defvar index: int 0)
  (defvar total: int 0)
  (while (< index limit)
    (inc! index)
    (if (= (% index 2) 0) (continue))
    (set! total (workflow-native total index)))
  total)

(defn workflow-square [x: int] -> int (* x x))
(defn workflow-score [x: int] -> int (+ 1 (workflow-square x) (workflow-native x (workflow-bump))))
(defn workflow-loop [limit: int] -> int
  (defvar index: int 0)
  (defvar total: int 1)
  (while (< index limit)
    (inc! index)
    (if (= (% index 2) 0) (continue))
    (set! total (workflow-native total index)))
  total)
